name: Teradyne
description: Teradyne makes automated test equipment: machines that test chips (AI compute, memory, mobile and other chips) before they ship, plus testers for electronics, defense and storage. It also owns a robotics business (Universal Robots collaborative arms and Mobile Industrial Robots autonomous mobile robots) that has lost money. Semiconductor Test was 84% of Q2 2026 revenue, up 128% year on year on AI-related compute and memory test. One direct customer was 19% of 2025 revenue.
